highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 is a servicing release delivering three rounds of upstream Skia m150 Ganesh bug fixes.

bullets.lead: Three rounds of chrome/m150 upstream bug fixes
bullets.detail: Three upstream syncs from the Skia chrome/m150 branch have been applied, pulling in Ganesh stability and correctness improvements from the Skia team.

bullets.lead: m150 line updated with additional Ganesh fixes
bullets.detail: A further round of Ganesh-focused fixes was merged into the release/4.150.x line ahead of this build.
